bibl.title: Mud from Memphis: P.Berl.Bibl. 6 and fertiliser production in Roman Egypt
bibl.seg: Elena Chepel, Mud from Memphis: P.Berl.Bibl. 6 and Fertiliser Production in Roman Egypt.
bibl.note: New edition of P. Berl. Bibl. [P. Berlin Staatsbibl.] 6 (= S.B. I, 423), which appears to be an acknowledgment of receipt of a leased ammokopregon ship. Argues that the ship was used for collecting silt fertiliser in the marshy parts of the Nile near Memphis, and that the name of the ship, Myrismos, is a Greek epithet of the Memphite god of the water lily and of fragrance, Nefertem. Memphis, ca. 225-245.
